# source: beamer user guide §12.7 (Splitting a Frame into Multiple Columns)
# and §9.5 (Dynamically Changing Text or Images) — §12.7's columns
# environment, column environment and \column command form, and §9.5's two
# environments, overprint and overlayarea. beamer is a class (it maps onto
# slides), so its rows probe a frame body under \documentclass{beamer}: the
# `frame` place. Both column spellings elaborate to the one columns row; a
# \column that is not at the top level of a columns body starts no column
# and is refused by name.
# §9.5's two environments take opposite stances, and the rows say which.
# overprint is alternation: one \onslide item inked per overlay step, an
# item holding block content included. An \onslide with no <spec> has no
# alternation in it (beamer reads a bare \onslide as "on every overlay"),
# so that body stands as written, as ONE reading, with W0302 naming the
# loss. overlayarea is not modelled: its body is kept under W0302 too, and
# its two size arguments go with the unknown wrapper (E0336 beside it).
# §10.2 (Adding Sections and Subsections) and §8.1 (Frames): a section hook is
# a command each section it opens calls right after its title, its starred
# code after a starred section, a later hook opening the later sections and
# a hook a group declares ending with it; the insert commands name the section
# in force; a frame holding only \sectionpage is the section's page; a frame's
# label option labels the frame. §10.5 (Adding a Table of Contents): \tableofcontents
# lists the unstarred sections and subsections, its options showing, shading
# or hiding them about the section in force; pausesections, which steps the
# list, is named. These rows probe the deck's body outside the frames: the
# `deck` place.
frame impl \begin{columns}[T]\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}x\end{column}\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}y\end{column}\end{columns}
frame impl \begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]\column{0.5\textwidth}x\column{0.5\textwidth}y\end{columns}
frame impl \begin{columns}\column{0.5\textwidth}x\begin{column}{0.5\textwidth}y\end{column}\end{columns}
frame refuse:W0104 \column{0.5\textwidth}x
frame impl \begin{overprint}\onslide<1> A first reading.\onslide<2> A second reading.\end{overprint}
frame impl \begin{overprint}\onslide<1>\begin{itemize}\item A listed point.\end{itemize}\onslide<2> A second reading.\end{overprint}
frame refuse:W0302 \begin{overprint}\onslide A reading with no step.\onslide<2> A second reading.\end{overprint}
frame refuse:W0302 \begin{overlayarea}{\textwidth}{3cm}\only<1>{A first reading.}\only<2>{A second reading.}\end{overlayarea}
deck impl \AtBeginSection{\begin{frame}{Outline}x\end{frame}}\section{Alpha}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \AtBeginSection[]{\begin{frame}x\end{frame}}\section*{Alpha}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \AtBeginSubsection{\begin{frame}x\end{frame}}\section{A}\subsection{B}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{Alpha}\begin{frame}{\insertsection}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{Alpha}\begin{frame}{\insertsectionhead}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{Alpha}\begin{frame}{\insertsectionnumber}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{Alpha}\subsection{Beta}\begin{frame}{\insertsubsection}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{Alpha}\begin{frame}\sectionpage\end{frame}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \begin{frame}[label=one]x\end{frame}\begin{frame}\ref{one}\end{frame}
deck impl \begin{frame}\tableofcontents\end{frame}\section{Alpha}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{Alpha}\begin{frame}\tableofcontents[currentsection]\end{frame}\section{Beta}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{A}\subsection{B}\begin{frame}\tableofcontents[currentsubsection]\end{frame}\subsection{C}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \begin{frame}\tableofcontents[hideallsubsections]\end{frame}\section{A}\subsection{B}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{A}\begin{frame}\tableofcontents[hideothersubsections]\end{frame}\section{B}\subsection{C}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{A}\begin{frame}\tableofcontents[sectionstyle=show/hide]\end{frame}\section{B}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck impl \section{A}\subsection{B}\begin{frame}\tableofcontents[subsectionstyle=show/shaded/hide]\end{frame}\section{C}\subsection{D}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
deck refuse:W0104 \begin{frame}\tableofcontents[pausesections]\end{frame}\section{A}\begin{frame}y\end{frame}
